description: Ministry of Home Affairs - Regulations made by the Minister of Affairs in terms of Section 2 of Pilgrimages Ordinance
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Home Affairs under the Pilgrimages Ordinance (Chapter 175). It establishes a comprehensive regulatory framework for managing pilgrimages at a specific religious festival site, including provisions for public health, sanitation, traffic control, and facility management. The content focuses entirely on legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories.
